quotes.text: ‘and what is the use of a book,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘without pictures or
conversations?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘Oh dear!
Oh dear! I shall be late!’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘ORANGE MARMALADE’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘Well!’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘after such a fall as this, I shall
think nothing of tumbling down stairs! How brave they’ll all think me at
home! Why, I wouldn’t say anything about it, even if I fell off the top
of the house!’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘I wonder how
many miles I’ve fallen by this time?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘I must be getting
somewhere near the centre of the earth. Let me see: that would be four
thousand miles down, I think--’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘--yes, that’s about the right distance--but then I wonder what Latitude
or Longitude I’ve got to?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘I wonder if I shall fall right THROUGH the
earth! How funny it’ll seem to come out among the people that walk with
their heads downward! The Antipathies, I think--’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘--but I shall have to ask them what the name of the country
is, you know. Please, Ma’am, is this New Zealand or Australia?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘And what an
ignorant little girl she’ll think me for asking! No, it’ll never do to
ask: perhaps I shall see it written up somewhere.’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘Dinah’ll miss me very much to-night, I should think!’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘I hope they’ll remember her saucer of milk at
tea-time. Dinah my dear! I wish you were down here with me! There are no
mice in the air, I’m afraid, but you might catch a bat, and that’s very
like a mouse, you know. But do cats eat bats, I wonder?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘Do cats eat bats? Do cats eat bats?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘Do
bats eat cats?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘Now, Dinah, tell me the truth:
did you ever eat a bat?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘Oh my ears
and whiskers, how late it’s getting!’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘and even if my head would go through,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘it
would be of very little use without my shoulders. Oh, how I wish I could
shut up like a telescope! I think I could, if I only knew how to begin.’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘which certainly was not here
before,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘DRINK ME’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘Drink me,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘No, I’ll look first,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘and
see whether it’s marked “poison” or not’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “poison”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘poison,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘poison,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘What a curious feeling!’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘I must be shutting up like a
telescope.’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: ‘for it might end, you know,’
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
‘in my going out altogether, like a candle. I wonder
what I should be like then?’
quotes.speaker: Unknown
